conditions.fixtureDisclosure: Production factory prepares only valid parking/scene starting positions and60HP/onefood for the functional flow; walking, quest steps, transactions and remount use actual controls. This is separate from the Chromium fresh native road acceptance.
conditions.touchLimits: Firefox has no Playwright is_mobile emulation; phone viewport+has_touch are tested. Sustained dpad input uses native mouse pointer holds; touch menus use native tap where supported. No physical Safari/iPhone claim.
conditions.sharedHostLoad: Concurrent Chromium HUD gallery on the same host during at least part of this final run. This is functional validation, not an isolated performance benchmark.
